superseded_cannot_vote.what_e6ce604_did_not_cover: the filter lived inside snapshot() alone. state_of() and read_all() are public and unfiltered, so the registry export -- a second consumer written after the fix -- would have inherited the unfiltered store with nothing going red. live_rows() is now the one place, and snapshot/state_of/registry_rows all route through it
additional_holes_closed: read_supersessions() SKIPPED an unparseable rule line; a dropped observation costs one data point, a dropped supersession re-admits a retracted experiment. It now raises EvidenceMemoryError.
before_utc is compared lexicographically, so a bare date ('2026-09-05') excluded NOTHING while reading as a retraction. _check_before_utc refuses anything shorter than a full timestamp.
before_utc=None now means the WHOLE family for all time.
a rule that excludes zero observations now carries a WARNING in the snapshot receipt instead of reading as 'applied, no effect'.
